Firstly, Suchita, who has been doing my eyebrows since the beginning, completely ruined them just a day before a wedding we were attending. After so many years of loyalty, it is extremely disappointing to see the salon trying to overcharge customers instead of valuing them. Poor service quality, lack of accountability, misleading offers, and an overall indifferent attitude make this place no longer trustworthy.

I would strongly advise others to think twice before visiting, especially if you expect professionalism, transparency, or basic customer respect.
